INSERT INTO TB_REPORT_HISTORY ( reportId, status, userId, modifiedAt, deviceIdx, currentDateTime, location, pileNo, pileStandard, drillingDepth, directDrillingDepth, stDrillingDepth, sdDrillingDepth, intrusionDepth, balance, connectLength, managedStandard, avgPenetrationValue, totalPenetrationValue, hammaT, fallMeter, createDate, pileType, method, totalConnectWidth, isDel, ultimateBearingCapacity, crossSection, hammaEfficiency, modulusElasticity, bigo, isDuple, sprCol1, gongSac ) SELECT R.id, #{status}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), R.deviceIdx, R.currentDateTime, R.location, R.pileNo, R.pileStandard, R.drillingDepth, R.directDrillingDepth, R.stDrillingDepth, R.sdDrillingDepth, R.intrusionDepth, R.balance, R.connectLength, R.managedStandard, R.avgPenetrationValue, R.totalPenetrationValue, R.hammaT, R.fallMeter, R.createDate, R.pileType, R.method, R.totalConnectWidth, R.isDel, R.ultimateBearingCapacity, R.crossSection, R.hammaEfficiency, R.modulusElasticity, R.bigo, R.isDuple, R.sprCol1, R.gongSac FROM TB_REPORT R WHERE R.id = #{reportId}
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TB_PENETRATION_HISTORY ( reportHistoryId, penetrationId, reportIdx, name, value ) SELECT #{id}, P.id, P.reportIdx, P.name, P.value FROM TB_PENETRATION P WHERE P.reportIdx = #{reportId}
INSERT INTO TB_PIECE_HISTORY ( reportHistoryId, pieceId, reportIdx, name, value ) SELECT #{id}, P.id, P.reportIdx, P.name, P.value FROM TB_PIECE P WHERE P.reportIdx = #{reportId}
